chapters.label: The counter
chapters.text: Olivier Giroud flicks the ball on. Arsenal break forward. New Year’s Day, 2017, against Crystal Palace. He sprints sixty yards into the box. A scorpion kick! Goal!

chapters.label: The scorpion
chapters.text: Watch again. Alexis Sánchez crosses, but the ball is behind Giroud. He dives forward and flicks it with his left heel, up over his own head. It loops over the keeper, in off the bar!

chapters.label: Be brave
chapters.text: Want to be brave like Giroud? If the ball comes behind you, keep your eyes on it. Stay calm. Try something creative, like a flick with your heel.
